delivery.ciSource: 本轮独立最终验证结果未确认。
delivery.qaSummary: 对设备售后服务与巡检协同系统(issue #533)以真实浏览器方式抽查 12 项验收：仅 B01 通过，B02–B04 失败，B05–B12 因业务账号与档案未关联、外部 AI 条件未知未执行(not_run)。关键缺陷：(1) 工单列表接口固定发送 status=all&priority=all 触发服务端枚举校验 500，列表恒为空；(2) service/engineers 档案的 userId 全为 null，登录账号与工程师档案未关联且无 UI/API 可关联，导致负责人李工/赵工登录后看不到任何工单(详情 404)、观察员触发 Policy 500，工单处理闭环、共享协作、站内消息、附件、统计等全部不可达；(3) Workflow“服务工单登记受理”默认停用，启用后节点“载入工单”报 Cannot find package '@nocobase/db'，受理实际由应用服务回退完成并标注 NOT-FOUND；(4) 观察员被读取策略拒绝(Repository forbidden by Policy)而非友好空态。已验证：主管创建客户/设备、必填与重复编号校验、客户设备不匹配/停用设备拒绝、未登录 401、受理按普通/紧急分支生成说明且重复受理幂等(changed:false/ALREADY_ACCEPTED)。证据见 evidence 目录截图与录屏。

rawRetro.summary: Implemented the device after-sales service and inspection collaboration system in the application source: three migrations (service core/orders/inspections), idempotent seeds for permission sets and fixed sample data (3 customers, 6 devices, 6 orders across every lifecycle state, 1 inspection, 2 published + 1 draft knowledge article, 2 engineer groups), composite authorization resources with row scopes (assigned-to-me, published-only), a Workflow artifact for supervisor acceptance with three-layer idempotency and in-app message to the assignee plus an application-owned fallback, temporary order sharing via the sharing-rules API (confidential orders rejected), PNG/DOCX attachments with preview/download/remove, Scheduler-driven inspection plans and overdue reminders, external device-report and status endpoints behind API-key authentication, a demo-account provisioning provider, and bilingual (en-US/zh-CN) pages for dashboard, orders list/detail, ledger, knowledge, inspections, messages, device manuals and AI assistant readiness. Verified: migrations + seeds applied against a real SQLite database and re-apply skips cleanly; tsc clean for client, node, server and database projects; eslint clean on every changed file; prettier clean on every changed file; locales check aligned; full vitest suite 44 files / 323 tests pass (including a new service collaboration test that catches a SQLite datetime-comparison bug in the overdue-reminder query, now fixed).

blockers.title: Overdue-order reminders never matched under SQLite
blockers.symptom: sendOverdueReminders returned zero reminders for orders whose deadline had clearly passed.
blockers.rootCause: The overdue filter compared a datetime column against a bound JavaScript Date (where('deadline','<',now)). Under better-sqlite3 the Date binding does not compare correctly with the stored datetime text, so no row matched; a string bound value did match.
blockers.resolution: Moved the overdue comparison out of SQL: the service now selects the open orders with a non-null deadline and filters in JavaScript with asIso + Date.getTime. Covered by tests/logic/service-collaboration.test.ts, which fails before the change and passes after.

blockers.title: AI chat surface cannot be added from the installed AI Employee package
blockers.symptom: No client extension or shadcn item for the AI chat box is available; client/extensions/nocobase-ai does not exist, the registry item ships only inside the plugin dist, and the package exports map has no ./registry/* entry. The shadcn registry URL returns HTML, and nocobaseAIService is not a public export.
blockers.rootCause: The AI Employee plugin ships its chat UI as a private registry payload and does not expose it through a supported public export, so the application cannot mount it without deep-importing plugin internals, which is forbidden.
blockers.resolution: Delivered /service/assistant as a readiness/diagnostics page instead of fabricating a chat surface: it reports whether the AI Employee and Knowledge Base plugins are registered, the employee/tool/skill/LLM counts, and links to /settings/ai. Reported as blocked rather than faked.

blockers.title: AI question answering and retrieval acceptance not run
blockers.symptom: The environment has no LLM service or embedding/vector database configured, so a manual knowledge base can be created and documents uploaded but segmentation and vectorization cannot be exercised end to end.
blockers.rootCause: AI retrieval requires a configured llmService/embeddingModel, which this environment does not provide.
blockers.resolution: Implemented the supervisor-facing /service/manuals page on the public knowledgeBaseService (create library, upload two bundled fictional Markdown manuals, trigger reprocess, show real document/segment/index status) and engineer read-only access. Real Q&A and retrieval verification recorded as blocked/not_run.

blockers.title: Knowledge-base write endpoints are only session-authenticated, not resource-authorized
blockers.symptom: The AI Knowledge Base plugin mounts its write HTTP actions with requireAuthentication only; its write policy checks only knowledgeBaseType === 'LOCAL'. An engineer could therefore call the plugin write actions directly even though the UI hides them.
blockers.rootCause: The plugin owns those endpoints and exposes no public hook for application-level resource authorization; changing it would require deep-importing plugin internals.
blockers.resolution: Enforced the supervisor-manage / engineer-read split in the application UI and page grants, and documented the server-side gap as a plugin-owned limitation. Not treated as fully resolved.

blockers.title: Workflow enablement has no public API and end-to-end run not observed
blockers.symptom: The workflow service does not expose a supported way to enable a source-managed workflow; acceptance relies on ensureArtifactMaterialized plus trigger with force:true, and no full boot-to-transition run was observed in this session.
blockers.rootCause: Programmatic workflow enablement is not a documented public contract of the installed plugin.
blockers.resolution: The provisioning provider materializes the artifact on boot (reported workflowReady=true in the app-server test logs) and the order service triggers it with force/eventKey, falling back to an application-owned transition that writes the same execution record. Marked unknown because the actual runtime acceptance transition was not verified end to end here.

blockers.title: Repository lint and format gates already fail at the pre-change baseline
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint (eslint . --max-warnings 0) exits non-zero on the untouched checkout with 319 problems (314 errors, 5 warnings), and pnpm format:check (prettier . --check) reports 178 unformatted files, mostly under .github/scripts plus pre-existing application files. Neither passes on a clean HEAD.
blockers.rootCause: The committed baseline does not satisfy its own configured quality gates, and the factory pipeline preflight (required-checks) lists no required checks, so those gates are not maintained. The 178 files must not be formatted here anyway because .github/ must not be modified.
blockers.resolution: Scoped eslint and prettier to the changed files, where both are clean, and relied on tsc plus the test suite as the working gates. Reported so the failing baselines are not mistaken for a regression from this change.

improvements.title: Avoid binding JavaScript Dates in SQLite comparisons
improvements.detail: Comparing a datetime column with a bound Date (where('deadline','<',now)) silently matches nothing with the better-sqlite3 adapter, while the same comparison with an ISO string works. Application code that filters by time should either bind a string or filter in JavaScript.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a shared query helper (or a lint rule) that rejects Date values on the right-hand side of a datetime comparison, and document the dialect behavior in the database reference.

improvements.title: eslint --fix corrupts query-builder row casts in this checkout
improvements.detail: @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion reports the explicit casts on loose query-builder rows as unnecessary; running eslint --fix removes them, after which tsc fails because the query builder widens selected columns to unknown.
improvements.suggestedChange: Do not run eslint --fix over server/service and server/routes row-mapped files; keep the narrowing in one helper (rowsOf/rowOf in server/service/values.ts) or add a targeted rule exception, rather than deleting the assertions.

improvements.title: Expose a public write-policy hook from the AI Knowledge Base plugin
improvements.detail: Application code cannot authorize the plugin's write actions, so role separation for knowledge content is UI-only.
improvements.suggestedChange: Ship an application-configurable write-policy or resource-authz registration from @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base so the owning application can attach its own resource/action checks without deep imports.

improvements.title: Provide a supported enablement API for source-managed workflows
improvements.detail: Applications can materialize an artifact but cannot enable it through a public contract, forcing a force-trigger plus application fallback.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document or export an enable/sync API on the workflow service so source-managed workflows become active without a fallback code path.

blockers.resolution: Implemented the supervisor-facing /service/manuals page on the public knowledgeBaseService (create library, upload two bundled fictional Markdown manuals, trigger reprocess, show real document/segment/index status) and engineer read-only access. Real Q&A and retrieval verification recorded as blocked/not_run.

blockers.title: Knowledge-base write endpoints are only session-authenticated, not resource-authorized
blockers.symptom: The AI Knowledge Base plugin mounts its write HTTP actions with requireAuthentication only; its write policy checks only knowledgeBaseType === 'LOCAL'. An engineer could therefore call the plugin write actions directly even though the UI hides them.
blockers.rootCause: The plugin owns those endpoints and exposes no public hook for application-level resource authorization; changing it would require deep-importing plugin internals.
blockers.resolution: Enforced the supervisor-manage / engineer-read split in the application UI and page grants, and documented the server-side gap as a plugin-owned limitation. Not treated as fully resolved.

blockers.title: Workflow enablement has no public API and end-to-end run not observed
blockers.symptom: The workflow service does not expose a supported way to enable a source-managed workflow; acceptance relies on ensureArtifactMaterialized plus trigger with force:true, and no full boot-to-transition run was observed in this session.
blockers.rootCause: Programmatic workflow enablement is not a documented public contract of the installed plugin.
blockers.resolution: The provisioning provider materializes the artifact on boot (reported workflowReady=true in the app-server test logs) and the order service triggers it with force/eventKey, falling back to an application-owned transition that writes the same execution record. Marked unknown because the actual runtime acceptance transition was not verified end to end here.

blockers.title: Repository lint and format gates already fail at the pre-change baseline
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint (eslint . --max-warnings 0) exits non-zero on the untouched checkout with 319 problems (314 errors, 5 warnings), and pnpm format:check (prettier . --check) reports 178 unformatted files, mostly under .github/scripts plus pre-existing application files. Neither passes on a clean HEAD.
blockers.rootCause: The committed baseline does not satisfy its own configured quality gates, and the factory pipeline preflight (required-checks) lists no required checks, so those gates are not maintained. The 178 files must not be formatted here anyway because .github/ must not be modified.
blockers.resolution: Scoped eslint and prettier to the changed files, where both are clean, and relied on tsc plus the test suite as the working gates. Reported so the failing baselines are not mistaken for a regression from this change.

improvements.title: Avoid binding JavaScript Dates in SQLite comparisons
improvements.detail: Comparing a datetime column with a bound Date (where('deadline','<',now)) silently matches nothing with the better-sqlite3 adapter, while the same comparison with an ISO string works. Application code that filters by time should either bind a string or filter in JavaScript.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a shared query helper (or a lint rule) that rejects Date values on the right-hand side of a datetime comparison, and document the dialect behavior in the database reference.

improvements.title: eslint --fix corrupts query-builder row casts in this checkout
improvements.detail: @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion reports the explicit casts on loose query-builder rows as unnecessary; running eslint --fix removes them, after which tsc fails because the query builder widens selected columns to unknown.
improvements.suggestedChange: Do not run eslint --fix over server/service and server/routes row-mapped files; keep the narrowing in one helper (rowsOf/rowOf in server/service/values.ts) or add a targeted rule exception, rather than deleting the assertions.

improvements.title: Expose a public write-policy hook from the AI Knowledge Base plugin
improvements.detail: Application code cannot authorize the plugin's write actions, so role separation for knowledge content is UI-only.
improvements.suggestedChange: Ship an application-configurable write-policy or resource-authz registration from @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base so the owning application can attach its own resource/action checks without deep imports.

improvements.title: Provide a supported enablement API for source-managed workflows
improvements.detail: Applications can materialize an artifact but cannot enable it through a public contract, forcing a force-trigger plus application fallback.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document or export an enable/sync API on the workflow service so source-managed workflows become active without a fallback code path.
